$schema_note: Every image on the site must have an entry here with status 'approved' before it ships. The build should fail if a page references an image id that is missing, unapproved, or lacks credit/licence. Slots below match the IMG-xx placeholders in the prototype.

rules.licence: Only images whose licence permits this use: Copernicus Sentinel data (free, attribution required); UNOSAT maps (reproduce with attribution); Wikimedia Commons under CC BY / CC BY-SA / public domain; UN, UNRWA, WHO, UNICEF photos only after checking each image's stated terms or getting written permission. Never use wire or stock photos (Reuters, AP, AFP, Getty, Magnific/Freepik) without a paid licence on file.
rules.verification: For every photo: confirm date and place (EXIF if present, reverse-image search, geolocation against Sentinel-2/Google Earth), confirm the original publisher, and record who checked it and when.
rules.dignity: No graphic injury or dead bodies. No identifiable children unless the original publisher states consent was obtained. Prefer places, objects and wide shots: an empty classroom, a water queue, rubble with a toy, a tent school.
rules.credit: Credit line shown on the image or in its caption, exactly as the licence requires.
